channels.name: Sub-Channel A / Sub-Channel B
channels.purpose: Two independent 32-bit (40-bit ECC) sub-channels per DIMM, each with its own CA bus, CS_n, and clock.

channels.name: DQ[31:0] (per sub-channel)
channels.purpose: 32-bit data bus (40 with ECC), double-pumped on DQS.

channels.name: DQS_t / DQS_c (per byte)
channels.purpose: Differential data strobe; data captured on both edges (double data rate).

channels.name: CA[13:0] + CS_n (per sub-channel)
channels.purpose: Command/address bus (2-cycle commands) and chip select.

global_signals.name: ALERT_n
global_signals.purpose: Write-CRC and command/address parity error alert.

global_signals.name: SPD-hub sideband
global_signals.purpose: I2C/I3C to PMIC / RCD / temperature sensors.

handshake_pairs.name: ACTIVATE / column access
handshake_pairs.rule: ACTIVATE opens a row; after tRCD a READ/WRITE column access is allowed.

handshake_pairs.name: WRITE / tWR / PRECHARGE
handshake_pairs.rule: tWR must elapse after the last write beat before PRECHARGE.

handshake_pairs.name: MRW / MRR
handshake_pairs.rule: Mode-register write/read over the 2-cycle CA protocol.

handshake_pairs.name: ALERT_n
handshake_pairs.rule: Signals a write-CRC or CA-parity error for retry/recovery.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Within a sub-channel, commands are issued as 2-cycle CA transactions on CA[13:0] qualified by CS_n and timed to CK_t/CK_c. A row must be ACTIVATEd (tRCD) before a column access and PRECHARGEd (tRP) before re-activation. The two sub-channels (A and B) are completely independent — traffic on one has no dependency on the other.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: A READ/WRITE requires: (1) the device initialized and trained (CA / read / write, DFE tap, VrefDQ/VrefCA, ZQ), (2) the target row open in the addressed bank, (3) bank-group spacing (tCCD_L within a group, tCCD_S across groups). Read data returns after CAS latency on DQ/DQS (double data rate) with on-die ECC applied; refresh (REFab/REFsb) must be maintained within tREFI.

channel_counts_per_x16_channel.note: DDR5 organizes a DIMM into two independent sub-channels rather than HBM-style per-die channels; an x16 device has 16 banks in 4 bank groups.

ordering_rules.command_order: Commands within a sub-channel are ordered to CK; the controller enforces tRCD/tRP/tRAS/tCCD/tWR/CL/tRFC.
ordering_rules.sub_channel: The two sub-channels are independent and may be scheduled concurrently.
ordering_rules.bank_group: Back-to-back accesses to different bank groups use tCCD_S; same-group accesses use the longer tCCD_L.
ordering_rules.data_order: BL16 beats are returned/accepted in burst order on DQ/DQS (double data rate).

logical_signaling_levels.name: Idle / precharged
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Banks precharged; CKE high; refresh within tREFI; DQ tri-stated.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active access
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Row open; READ/WRITE BL16 bursts on DQ/DQS.
